guide-entry-07b8af1540584bee278b0139.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its tenth session , 28 April to 4 July 1958 The Commission examined the text of the provisional draft in the light of the observations of Governments and of the conclusions drawn from them by the Special Rapporteur . As a result, the Commission made a number of changes in the provisional draft, adopting a final text with commentaries . It decided to recommend to the General Assembly that the draft articles on diplomatic intercourse and immunities should be recommended to Member States with a view to the conclusion of a convention. Discussion in Plenary : 448th and 449th meetings (22 and 23 May 1958), 451st , 452nd , 453rd , 454th , 455th , 456th , 457th , 458th , 459th , 460th , 461st , 462nd , 463rd , 464th , 465th , 466th , 467th and 468th meetings (28 May to 20 June 1958), and 474th , 475th , 476th , 477th and 478th meetings (30 June to 4 July 1958) ILC Report, A/3859 (A/13/9), 1958, chap.
